name: Uwakuni Misuzu
source:
She is the wife of the president and a company executive. She is a calm and collected boss who is perfect at her job. She appears to be strict and cold, but she takes good care of others. 

She has been paying special attention to Nobuyuki, but he doesn't seem to understand her. She feels that Nobuyuki's marriage has taken something away from him

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_237.html]official site[/url]]
